narrative.overview: User-selected Details 1 Icon Studio is the current primary page. Pink manicure photography retains Variant 1 positioning and veil. Burgundy Georgia headings, pill actions, menu icons, a calendar CTA, and inline service labels form the selected static design. Header replacement selection is pending.
keyCharacteristics: Menu line icons and inline service labels
Location and brand footer metadata without divider
dos: Retain the supplied image and pink brand.
Preserve disabled controls and the fixed viewport.
Account for final CSS text-size overrides.
donts: Do not add scrolling or interaction to the scoped artifact.
Do not invent hover or focus states for disabled controls.
Do not restore the removed service summary bar or footer divider without a new request.
Do not treat optional static variants as the primary design authority.
